message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought given air. I rise in the throat, strike the teeth, part the lips, and become meaning. I can soothe, command, confess, deceive, bless, wound, persuade, and sing.

I happen only when voiced—fleeting, time-bound—yet I can outlast my moment in memory, rumor, oath, and echo. I need a speaker and a listener, even if the listener is the dark. I am cadence and pause as much as words. I am accent, stammer, laughter, sigh.

Name me, and I arrive. Silence is my edge.
